projectDescription: A Microsoft Word VSTO add-in (ShivaNegar) for Persian academic document authoring, providing structured thesis/dissertation templates, Persian text tools, citation management, and cloud-based document synchronization for Iranian universities.
keyFeatures: VSTO Microsoft Word add-in for Persian academic document authoring
University-specific structured templates (thesis, dissertation, project, school research)
Persian text correction tools: half-space insertion, punctuation, spelling correction
Caption management for figures, tables, and formulas
Citation manager with APA and IEEE styles, BibTeX import
Cloud document synchronization via shivanegar.ir API
Export to PDF, grayscale PDF, and unlocked Word (.docx)
Quran and Nahj al-Balagha verse insertion
Dedication page and Besmellah page tools
